iou_convention: empty prediction AND empty GT -> IoU=1.0 (matches eval_sample's own convention: inter/union if union>0 else 1.0). Every 'all_shapes' aggregate below is paired with a 'nonzero_gt_only' one because this convention trivially inflates ceiling and all_zero-baseline scores on exact-zero-GT shapes (see gt_composition.n_zero_gt for the count).
